'''2008 Match Play Championship Day 1 Chris Westergard LS You Can Either Profit By This...''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Chris Westergard]] at [[2008 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|EJP-L-youcaneitherprofitbythis.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS14]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
